newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq says some MCI trades to be evaluated.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq says some MCI trades to be evaluated.

text.p: Nasdaq said it would evaluate the validity of all trades in MCI Communications Corp which appeared to have been made after the stock was halted for news pending at 1327 EST/1827 EST.
One trader said the trades that were showing up after the halt were "sold out of sequence" transactions that likely occurred before the halt, but were reported or "printed" after the halt.
He added that each of these traded will likely be examined by Nasdaq to determine when and under what circumstances the trades took place.
MCI Communications announced on Friday it was in talks about a "business combination" with British Telecommunications Plc, which already has a 20 percent stake in the U.S. firm.
The MCI was halted at 27-1/4, up 1-7/8.

Nasdaq spokesman Michael Robinson later said he could not yet tell if any trades had been made after the halt, but that the Nasdaq was looking into it. Robinson added that the company did not yet know when the halt would be lifted.
